page: Google Cloud Platform c4a-highmem-32-lssd is a memory-optimized server instance built on the arm64 CPU architecture. It features 32 dedicated virtual CPUs and 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a ratio of 8.0 GB of RAM per core. The instance includes 2416 GB of local NVMe SSD storage distributed across six local drives, providing high-speed, low-latency local storage capacity directly attached to the host.

Operating on an ARM-based architecture with dedicated CPU allocation, this server family is designed to deliver predictable compute performance without resource sharing. The inclusion of 2416 GB of local NVMe SSD storage eliminates the need for external block storage for high-throughput operations, improving qualitative cost efficiency for I/O-intensive workloads. The 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio provides a dense memory footprint suitable for memory-bound applications that do not require GPU acceleration.

The combination of 256.0 GB of RAM, 32 dedicated arm64 vCPUs, and high-speed local NVMe SSD storage makes this instance suitable for memory-intensive databases, caching layers, large-scale data processing pipelines, and local storage-heavy workloads. It is particularly configured for environments that benefit from ARM architecture efficiency and require substantial local scratch space.
